latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Subtitle Editor version 1.0.0.
- Add captions automatically in English and Spanish with customizable styles (white text, black outline).
- Supports uploading MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM files up to 500MB.
- Cloud rendering delivers captioned videos in 30-60 seconds.
- No manual editing or syncing required—just describe the result you want.
- Ideal for YouTubers and content creators seeking fast, accurate subtitles.
